attributes.label: How we work
attributes.title:
Clear steps.
*No guesswork.*
attributes.intro: Every engagement follows the same five steps, so you always know what’s happening and what you’ll get.

steps.title: Discovery call
steps.deliverable: You get: a fit check and next steps
steps.body: A 30-minute call to understand your goals, market, budget and what you’ve already tried. If we’re not the right fit, we’ll tell you.

steps.title: Audit & strategy
steps.deliverable: You get: a prioritized growth plan
steps.body: We review your search visibility, ads, landing pages, email and tracking, then rank every opportunity by impact and effort.

steps.title: Scope & setup
steps.deliverable: You get: fixed scope and working tracking
steps.body: We agree deliverables and timelines in writing, then set up accounts, analytics, pixels, CRM and creative briefs.

steps.title: Create & launch
steps.deliverable: You get: live campaigns and content
steps.body: Our team writes, designs and builds: pages, ad creatives, videos, emails and automations, then launches in priority order.

steps.title: Optimize & report
steps.deliverable: You get: a monthly report and review call
steps.body: We test, improve and report on leads and revenue, not vanity metrics. Then we plan the next month together.
